title: Latin America Internationals (São Paulo): Vinícius Fernandez (BR) wins
detail: Limitless lists Vinícius Fernandez (Brazil) as winner of the 2026–27 São Paulo International, 2,646 players. I did not check the deck, and web searches turned up conflicting names from the 2025 edition, so treat the winner as per Limitless only.

title: Champions League Chiba (22 Nov): still no result posted
detail: Limitless's list shows nothing for Chiba yet. Next up: Regional Stuttgart, Sat 28 Nov, then Las Vegas 5 Dec.

title: Japan's Aura Seeker (ME7) is due Fri 27 Nov, four days away
detail: Mega Lucario Z ex, Mega Absol Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex. The date comes from PokeBeach and Japanese shops still call it unofficial, so confirm before pre-ordering. It becomes Flowing Fists in English.

title: OP-18 English is out; French pre-releases run to 28 Nov
detail: English OP-18 launched Fri 20 Nov. French pre-release events (€35 for 6 French boosters) run 21–28 Nov; the official French release date is still unconfirmed. Next One Piece regional: Alicante, Sat 28 Nov. Oklahoma City (21 Nov) results are still not posted.
